exposure: Patient characteristics and clinical factors used as predictors in machine learning models
cohort: The study cohort consisted of class III obese women (BMI >=40) who underwent labor induction at the study institution.
finding: Logistic regression was the most accurate model for predicting cesarean deliveries in nulliparous women, while Random Forest performed best in the combined nulliparous and multiparous dataset.
mod_finding: The study identified logistic regression as the most accurate predictive model for cesarean delivery in nulliparous women and Random Forest for the combined nulliparous and multiparous cohort.
